touch_gesture_navigation: Single-tap: Select node and open quick stats HUD
Double-tap: Expand/collapse child components on touch canvas
Long-press: Open interactive visual configuration wheel
Pinch-to-zoom: Scale node detail from summary chip to full telemetry view
Two-finger drag: Draw dynamic pipeline edge connection to another node
touch_canvas_modeling.expand_behavior: Dynamically fetched from graph server on expand touch gesture

loop_impact_analysis.state_mutation_scope: Mutates loop state via doctor context boundaries.
loop_impact_analysis.concurrency_and_blocking: Non-blocking async worker execution with lock safety.

recommendations_for_engine: Optimize doctor token accounting for 600k context scale using measured envelope tiering.
Provide touch-native visual handles for direct manipulation on mobile/tablet touch displays.
Enforce strict state invariants so expanding doctor dynamically does not invalidate active turn execution.
